metric_families.purpose: Measure candidate association with the declared target using a target-appropriate governed metric.
Represent estimation uncertainty with a governed interval or uncertainty procedure.
Compare candidate behavior with an appropriate permutation, negative-control or empirical-null distribution.
Measure stability across governed time partitions without peeking at protected confirmatory outcomes.
Measure replication of a frozen candidate hypothesis on protected confirmatory evidence.
Record search-space/hypothesis multiplicity and the selected correction procedure.
Record sample/information sufficiency under candidate-appropriate dependence assumptions.
Describe candidate behavior across the governed regime taxonomy.
Describe candidate behavior across governed observation/decision horizons.
Estimate research-level turnover/cost implications without execution-grade validation.
Record sensitivity to liquidity/market-capacity context without risk approval.
Measure incremental information relative to governed baselines using dependence, ablation or nested comparison as appropriate.
Assess sensitivity to nearby parameter/assumption changes.
Assess research-level cross-asset sanity without claiming production generalization.
